snippet.title: Red Sunrise - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Red Sunrise - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2244350/Red_Sunrise/

Red Sunrise - A team-based, realistic, hardcore first-person shooter that tells about violent military conflicts in different parts of the world. The player will take on the role of a mercenary and perform various combat missions in the extreme conditions of modern warfare. In hot spots around the world, you have to promote the business interests of private military companies, government agencies, as well as various gangs. By completing contracts of varying difficulty, you will earn money and reputation in the world of professional mercenaries.
